scientific.integrity: The claim is derived from the exact scalar clipped heavy-ball recurrence. Local stability follows from the Jury criterion for the unclipped linearization; period-two completeness follows from the fact that equal-magnitude opposite clipped gradients are either both unsaturated or both saturated; normal attraction follows from an exact affine recurrence in the strictly saturated alternating region.
limitations: One-dimensional positive quadratic only; no multidimensional, stochastic, or nonquadratic extension is claimed.
No global basin or exhaustive classification of periods greater than two is claimed.
Local normal attraction excludes endpoint cycles on the clipping kink.
The result applies to clipping the current gradient before raw heavy-ball momentum; other clipping or momentum orderings are different algorithms.

title: Sharp two-cycle bifurcation for gradient-clipped heavy-ball on a scalar quadratic
